requirements.requirement: Reuse the persistent command, operation/audit and formal readback framework without a second executor
requirements.implementationEvidence: aiTaskWriteBridgeV2 delegates execution to executeConfirmedAiTool; aiTaskOperationReadbackV2 is a task-bound read model

requirements.requirement: Persist operation association and idempotency before command dispatch
requirements.implementationEvidence: appendProtectedCommandStep persists confirmation operationId and formal preflight idempotencyKey before executeConfirmedAiTool calls the executor

requirements.requirement: Lost command response becomes UNKNOWN_EFFECT and RECONCILING without a new key or command replay
requirements.implementationEvidence: executeAiTaskConfirmedWriteV2 marks only non-4xx post-admission failures UNKNOWN_EFFECT then RECONCILING

requirements.requirement: A completed formal operation is resolved by task-bound read-only operation lookup and trusted final receipt
requirements.implementationEvidence: readTaskCommandOperationV2 binds the persisted command capability and idempotencyKey to the current task association; reconcileAiTaskCommandV2 completes only completed operation/audit receipts

requirements.requirement: Absent, pending, or ambiguous operation evidence remains safely reconciling
requirements.implementationEvidence: reconcileAiTaskCommandV2 emits COMMAND_RECONCILING and retains RECONCILING for MISSING/PENDING/AMBIGUOUS

requirements.requirement: Formal business rejection is not retried as an unknown effect
requirements.implementationEvidence: known 4xx command failure marks the admitted step and task FAILED

requirements.requirement: Same-card concurrent/replayed delivery has no duplicate business effect
requirements.implementationEvidence: existing confirmation consumption protocol serializes one token; task admission records one command step

requirements.requirement: Same idempotency key with different arguments is rejected and audit failure rolls back the command
Cancellation after command admission preserves the known effect and reconciles rather than claiming cancellation/rollback
requirements.implementationEvidence: cancel route persists cancellation when COMMAND is in flight; command completion routes to RECONCILING and reconciliation ends PARTIAL

requirements.requirement: Only part stock and part price are in scope; no new configuration/order/quotation/CAD/print write slice
requirements.implementationEvidence: N6_1_WRITE_TOOLS allowlist remains adjust_part_stock and batch_update_prices
requirements.testEvidence: N6.1/N6.2 focused bridge tests and capability contract regression

requirements.requirement: No direct model-visible write capability or direct business SQLite mutation path
requirements.implementationEvidence: task routes are owner-bound server bridge endpoints; actual write stays under executeConfirmedAiTool and formal APIs

requirements.requirement: Final repository gates include the plain deterministic deep-api invocation without an external market dependency
requirements.implementationEvidence: scripts/run-deep-api-smoke.cjs seeds a completed current-BJT daily market snapshot only into the temporary isolated SQLite clone before the API starts; production market service behavior is unchanged
